name: site.stellarator/formal-verifier
title: Stellarator Formal Algebra & GPU Microarchitecture Verifier
description: Exact Golay G24 syndrome, GPU Wave32 LDS bank-conflict, and 64-bit modular witness verifier.

tools.name: verify_golay_leech_syndrome
tools.description: Exact algebraic syndrome decoder and octad weight verifier in the extended binary Golay code G_24 (24-bit codeword space, minimum distance 8, Steiner system S(5,8,24)). Eliminates LLM bit-error hallucinations.

word24.description: 24-bit vector as 0x-prefixed hex (e.g. 0x000807) or decimal integer in [0, 16777215]

tools.name: verify_wave32_lds_bank_conflict
tools.description: Exact 32-bank Shared SRAM (LDS) half-wave bank-conflict & stall-cycle calculator for 32-lane SIMT GPU kernels (4-byte bank width, bank=(addr>>2)&31, half-waves lo=0..15 and hi=16..31 with hardware same-dword broadcast deduplication and exec_mask).

lane_addrs.description: Up to 32 byte addresses for lanes 0..31

tools.name: verify_u64_modular_witness
tools.description: Exact 64-bit unsigned wrapping arithmetic verifier: computes (x *% multiplier +% addend) mod 2^64, quotient/remainder, popcount, and 32-bit hi/lo register limbs.

addend.description: Optional decimal or 0x hex u64 addend (default 0)

tools.name: scan_prompt_smuggling
tools.description: Deterministic security scanner for untrusted tool/document inputs: detects Unicode Tag steganography (U+E0000..U+E007F), variation-selector smuggling, bidirectional control overrides, and role-boundary spoofing.

tools.name: verify_fi22_coclique
tools.description: Exact coclique (independent set), maximality, and Delsarte-Hoffman 45-bound verifier on the 3510-vertex Fischer sporadic simple group graph Fi22 = SRG(3510, 693, 180, 126) with 1,216,215 edges.

vertices.description: Array of distinct vertex IDs in [0, 3509] (or comma-separated string, max 64 vertices)
